the LG molecules are inserted into the PC membrane interior in a similar way as Chol, but with a lower degree of penetration and without affecting the membrane fluidity.

the LG molecule is a promising antioxidant agent for the protection of the cell membrane.

the LG molecules are capable of penetrating into the lipid bilayer and that the PC–LG interaction results in the membrane compacting.

the presence of LG in the membrane can be considered as a factor which can modulate the membrane properties.

the PC–LG system can be used as a model of a non-raft domain in the plasma membranes.
